original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克：六名被指为恐怖分子的人员在潘加内被捕
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 卢旺达军队在协助莫桑比克武装部队打击恐怖主义期间，于德尔加杜角省马科米亚区的潘加内村抓获六名被指为恐怖组织成员的人员。据《莫桑比克信报》援引的消息源称，这些嫌疑人此前混入当地居民，在为叛乱分子购买食物时被发现并报告给卢旺达军方据点。该事件目前为单一来源报道，嫌疑人身份及所属组织尚未获得独立确认。

location.raw_text: village of Pangane, in the Macomia district, northern province of Cabo Delgado

key_facts.fact: 卢旺达军队抓获六名被指为恐怖组织成员的人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Rwandan troops, who are helping the Mozambican armed forces in the fight against terrorism, have captured six individuals allegedly being part of the terrorist group

key_facts.fact: 抓捕发生在马科米亚区潘加内村
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the individuals were captured last Friday night in the village of Pangane, in the Macomia district

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人被指混入当地居民，在为叛乱分子购买食物时被发现
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: It is believed that the suspects had infiltrated the local population. However, they were then discovered and reported to a Rwandan military position located in the village while purchasing food for the insurgents

key_facts.fact: 该恐怖组织自2017年以来在德尔加杜角省北部地区实施极端暴力
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the terrorist group that has been carrying out extreme violence against districts of the northern province of Cabo Delgado since 2017

uncertainties: 六名被捕者是否为恐怖组织成员尚未获得独立确认，报道使用“被指”表述
事件目前仅有一个来源（单一来源），尚缺乏交叉验证
嫌疑人所属具体组织未被明确说明
